title: Modchart Converter
intro: Copy an NVME Lua modchart to the clipboard, and then click "Convert Clipboard".
help:
This tool performs a practical first-pass conversion.
Reassign the steps, remove the NVMe radian helpers, and remember that fieldYaw is the name of the Plus side.
